recipe: POST https://api.kimi.ai/coding/v1/chat/completions (Moonshot's Kimi coding endpoint, an OpenAI-compatible server that serves only Chat Completions), with a Kimi Code sign-in's bearer token (not recorded), the request below sent as is, the answer's body kept byte for byte.
scenario: The same request without reasoning_content on the assistant message: the model calls the same tool again instead of answering, which is why the gateway sends the reasoning back (design §10.3).
